Wake up and open your eyes to the coordinated script being played out right in front of us by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the scenes. They expect us to swallow this neat little fairy tale about a conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran magically causing a sharp rise in global oil prices and hitting fuel costs in India. 

Look closely at their own admissions: petrol and diesel prices remain stable for now, and the government has implemented measures such as reducing excise duties to shield consumers from potential price hikes. But do not be fooled by this completely inverted picture. That is not protection at all; it is a calculated manipulation of the economic levers designed to increase government control and engineer a setup that leads to increased inflation. They are manufacturing the crisis. 

They keep telling us that India relying heavily on crude oil imports leaves the situation precarious and the long-term effects on the economy are yet to be seen, but this is all part of their grand design to destabilize the populace. The whole narrative about managing the crisis is just a smoke screen to hide their true, deeper motives. Don't fall for their official explanations.
